about: What HISTOR watches beyond the official MCP registry. Remote servers: popular ones the registry does not carry, each answering initialize and tools/list without credentials when added — HISTOR's own picks and the connection URLs in github.com/jaw9c/awesome-remote-mcp-servers and github.com/punkpeye/awesome-remote-mcp-servers. Packages (npm:<name>, pypi:<name>), run in the gVisor package sandbox: every npm package found by npm search (keywords mcp, mcp-server, modelcontextprotocol, model-context-protocol, and text searches) that is MCP-related, ships a command and is not deprecated, and every PyPI project with 'mcp' in its name that publishes a wheel (no sdist is ever built: that would run the package's code). Ordered by downloads — npm's weekly count, PyPI's 30-day count from the top-15 000 list divided by 4.3 — and that is the order a crawl runs never-observed packages in, wherever they are listed; PyPI projects outside the top 15 000 come last, newest release first. Field 'source' says where each entry came from. Names are assigned by HISTOR in its own namespace (urn:awr:mtl:1:registry:histor.modelmarket.dev/curated), so a label never claims a registry listing the server does not have. An endpoint or package the official registry lists is read from the registry instead.
